content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

- **Issue:** The duplicate-numbered § 12.4 (p0046) imposes on Juniper Ridge a term-plus-24-month ban on developing, marketing, selling or acquiring any product or service competing with Cobalt, in any territory, with no carve-outs. This is walk-away territory (post-term >12 months, undefined scope) and fails the fallback on scope, duration and carve-outs.
- **Conflict:** It contradicts § 12.3 (p0044), where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Delete p0046 entirely, leaving § 12.3 to govern; the comment offers the narrowed fallback (single named product, term only, 12 months, carve-outs) if Cobalt needs protection.
- **Not flagged here:** the no-hire covenant at p0045, which belongs to the separate no-hire rule.
